purpose: Govern two internal AI systems that adversarially co-create a game by repeatedly producing, attacking, improving, verifying, and promoting every material game artifact under long-form continuity and rights/provenance constraints.

rival_a.isolation: private working state; only governed artifacts/evidence/canon are shared
rival_a.rotation: builder on odd rounds, challenger on even rounds

rival_b.isolation: private working state; only governed artifacts/evidence/canon are shared
rival_b.rotation: challenger on odd rounds, builder on even rounds

arbiter.kind: deterministic control plane, not a third AI

forge_10000.description: extreme long-horizon refinement for flagship artifacts

three_stage_cycle.action: Produce the best complete candidate possible from the task contract, canon, evidence, game state, source-rights envelope, and current champion.
three_stage_cycle.prohibition: No unlicensed expressive material may be copied into the candidate.

three_stage_cycle.action: Adversarially attack the candidate across correctness, fun, novelty, coherence, aesthetics, performance, accessibility, implementation feasibility, continuity, and rights risk; then produce a materially improved challenger rather than critique-only text.
three_stage_cycle.presentation_note: The UI may render playful rival banter or laughter, but banter is non-authoritative and must never replace specific actionable criticism.

three_stage_cycle.action: Rebut, adopt, or synthesize the challenger using evidence. The deterministic arbiter applies hard gates and promotes only a Pareto-safe winner or synthesis; ties preserve both branches for the next round.
three_stage_cycle.prohibition: A model cannot promote its own candidate without independent rival challenge and deterministic gate evaluation.

round_semantics.role_rotation: Roles swap every round to prevent one model from becoming a permanent author or critic.
round_semantics.champion_memory: Only promoted artifacts and explicit rejected-alternative summaries enter durable shared memory.
round_semantics.branch_preservation: Materially different high-scoring alternatives may remain as challenger branches; no silent overwrite.
round_semantics.checkpoints: Checkpoint at every promoted round and every 10/100/1000 rounds according to effort tier.
round_semantics.resume: Resume from the last durable champion, exact canon version, source-rights snapshot, round number, rival identities, scorer version, and random seed set where applicable.
round_semantics.forbidden_stop_condition: Wall-clock duration alone; the effort modes intentionally have no time limit.

artifact_atomization.principle: Every game artifact is decomposed to the smallest useful governed unit without losing its parent context.
artifact_atomization.requirement: Atomic inspection never severs provenance to the containing scene, story, system, project pillar, or canon state.

longform_consistency.prime_directive: No local improvement may damage long-form story, world, character, gameplay, visual, audio, systemic, or thematic consistency.
longform_consistency.failure_behavior: Contradiction blocks promotion unless explicitly marked as intentional unreliable narration, retcon proposal, branch divergence, dream/simulation, or other declared narrative device.

source_universe.objective: Use the broadest legally permitted game-development knowledge base while keeping source identity and rights status attached.
classes: platform and console documentation available to the project
market observations and public factual metadata
source_universe.ingestion_rule: Availability is not permission to copy. Every source receives provenance, rights status, allowed uses, retention, and output constraints before it can influence production artifacts.

rights_and_originality.goal: Minimize copyright, license, trademark, trade-dress, confidential-information, and provenance risk across the game-building pipeline; absolute worldwide non-infringement cannot be guaranteed by software alone.
hard_rules: Do not reproduce protected text, code, art, music, audio, characters, maps, levels, logos, or other expressive material without a compatible permission basis.
Reference-only sources may inform abstract techniques, facts, constraints, and high-level ideas but not supply expressive output.
Preserve license notices and attribution where the governing license requires them.
Block export when provenance is missing for incorporated third-party material.
Run near-duplicate and similarity review across text, code, image, audio/music, names/marks, level layouts, and distinctive character/world elements before promotion.
Quarantine suspiciously similar output for human/legal review rather than attempting automatic legal conclusions.
Never claim that a similarity score is a legal determination.
rights_and_originality.originality_pressure: The rivals receive an explicit novelty objective: solve the design problem from first principles and project-specific canon rather than imitate a named work, franchise, studio, artist, composer, writer, or codebase.
